name: Project Context page and the run trace's injected specs row
description: From the sidebar, open Project Context and confirm the seeded docs/architecture.md document opens by default (AC-4); Refresh re-asks the API without losing the list (AC-8). Then open PR #482's demo run (D10 seed, server/src/db/seed-project-context.ts) and confirm the trace drawer's Prompt assembly section shows the labelled, untrusted Project context row (AC-32). Deterministic: no LLM call, read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo and seed-project-context.ts has set its clone_path and inserted the fixed-id demo run — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md), which points DEVDIGEST_CLONE_DIR at a fresh temp dir per run so the demo checkout is isolated from the developer's real clone dir.

steps.label: load the app root
land on the PR list
open the sidebar Project Context nav item
navigate to the Project Context route
context data settles
the seeded docs/architecture.md heading opens by default (AC-4)
ask the API to scan the checkout again (AC-8)
the reindex settles
the list and preview are still shown after Refresh
back to the app root
land on the PR list again
